title: Cursor mode
launch: Let the AI take the cursor
placeholder: What should I do? For example: open Bluetooth settings and turn it on
privacy: Screenshots of your screen stay on this computer and are sent only to the model you chose. Esc or a mouse movement stops the AI at once.

model.none: No model available — set it up in the settings

hint.abort: Press Esc or move the mouse to stop at once.

consent.title: Allow screenshots for {{provider}}?
consent.body: To control the cursor, the AI sees your screen: Orkestr sends screenshots and the names of on-screen controls to {{provider}}. Nothing else leaves this computer, Orkestr's own windows are hidden from the screenshots, and you can revoke this in the settings at any time.

errors.noBackend: No model can control the cursor: {{reason}}

say.noBackend: No model is available for cursor mode.

settings.title: Cursor mode
settings.intro: In cursor mode the AI moves the mouse and types to perform your task, then hands control back. Start it by voice («Jarvis, take control …»), from Assistant mode, the orb or Ctrl+Alt+J.
settings.sourceSubscriptionsHint: Uses the Claude Code CLI and the Codex CLI you are signed in to — no API key, it counts against your subscription limits.
settings.sourceApiHint: Uses Anthropic / OpenAI vision models with the API keys from the vault — billed per request.
settings.failover: If a model stops working (sign-in, usage limit, rate limit, network, model unavailable), the next one in this list takes over at once.
settings.abortOnMouse: Moving the mouse stops the AI (Esc always does)
settings.minimize: Minimize Orkestr while the AI works

commands.start: Cursor mode: let the AI take control
commands.stop: Cursor mode: stop and take control back
